description: This file implements serialization and deserialization mechanisms for various PyTorch objects such as tensors, storage, and CUDA-specific resources to enable multiprocessing IPC communication. It defines functions for reducing and rebuilding tensors, sparse tensors, nested tensors, CUDA tensors, and storage objects, along with managing shared cache states. Additionally, it registers specific reduction functions with the 'multiprocessing.reduction' module to facilitate proper serialization.

classes.name: StorageWeakRef
classes.description: A weak reference to a Storage object, holding a cdata representing the Storage pointer and a method to free the weak reference.

classes.name: SharedCache
classes.description: A thread-safe dictionary mapping multiprocessing handles to StorageWeakRef objects, managing shared Storage references with automatic cleanup of dead references.
